evals.prompt: Design a 900 ms fireball impact effect for a 60 FPS mobile game. Include phases, layers, budgets, and a reduced-motion fallback.
evals.expected_output: A machine-checkable effect packet with a shared lifecycle, bounded particles/draw calls, and an explicit reduced-motion behavior.
assertions: The output defines ordered effect phases
The output separates a primary visual layer from supporting layers
The output includes particle, draw-call, or overdraw budgets
The output includes a reduced-motion fallback
The output recommends target-device profiling rather than claiming a budget guarantees performance

evals.prompt: A spell effect allocates hundreds of particles every frame, uses full-resolution blur, and obscures the hit zone. Diagnose it and give a repair order.
evals.expected_output: A diagnosis prioritizing allocation/pooling, downsampled blur, and gameplay readability before adding more spectacle.
assertions: The output identifies per-frame allocation as a performance risk
The output recommends pooling or reuse
The output recommends downsampling or bounding blur work
The output treats the obscured hit zone as a readability defect
The output includes measurement on representative hardware
